My main interests include Disney movies and games, particularly those involving strategy and villains. I'm also exploring religious themes and cultural discussions, especially those related to Shia Islam and Argentine culture. In my free time, I enjoy browsing Reddit, especially in the evenings after college. I'm single and currently focusing on my studies and personal interests.
